## [1.3.0](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/compare/v1.2.1...v1.3.0) (2026-11-18)

### ✨ New Features

* add Change package name patch (ported from patched-up, off by default) ([94785ea](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/commit/94785ead6396b2c50385ea8dfed9168811ed30fb))
* **googlenews:** add Enable CustomTabs patch (ported from patched-up) ([d89c3ac](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/commit/d89c3acdaade27c156baa6c261f61ea06b9a3418))
* **googlenews:** add GmsCore support patch with the MicroG sign-in fix built in (ported from patched-up), replacing the separate Declare MicroG in manifest queries patch ([2efc934](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/commit/2efc93411bb72d8fb25a5daa9d9b85eb0f1a9cff))

patches.name: Swipe to add/remove on new episodes
patches.description: On the New episodes screen, swipe an episode left or right to add it to the playlist, or to remove it if it is already there.

patches.name: Swipe to add/remove on recent episodes
patches.description: On the Recent episodes screen, swipe an episode left or right to add it to the playlist, or to remove it if it is already there.

patches.name: Swipe to remove from playlist
patches.description: Swipe an episode left or right in the Playlist to remove it from the playlist. Swiping between the Playlist tabs no longer works, tapping the tab titles does.

patches.name: Enable CustomTabs
patches.description: Enables CustomTabs to open articles in your default browser.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows Google News to sign in via MicroG (GmsCore) instead of Google Play Services when installed under a renamed package.

## [1.3.1](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/compare/v1.2.1...v1.3.1) (2026-11-18)

v1.3.0 was withdrawn: its Google News build could not sign in. This release includes everything from v1.3.0 plus the fix.

### ✨ New Features (from v1.3.0)

* add Change package name patch (ported from patched-up, off by default) ([94785ea](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/commit/94785ead6396b2c50385ea8dfed9168811ed30fb))

* **googlenews:** add GmsCore support patch with the MicroG sign-in fix built in (ported from patched-up), replacing the separate Declare MicroG in manifest queries patch ([2efc934](https://github.com/way-lo/waylo-patches/commit/2efc93411bb72d8fb25a5daa9d9b85eb0f1a9cff))
